value.title: Collector layer identity is stable and duplicate-safe
value.statement: A project-managed layer keeps account, remote id and project-origin metadata as one identity. Loading or rebuilding a spatial cache must not persist a partially initialized layer config. A managed-layer 404 is resolved by composition sync, never by silently converting the layer to an unmanaged local vector. Before additions, composition sync indexes physical layers by account plus remote id: one matching layer with only missing origin may be repaired in place, while duplicate, manual, wrong-kind or mismatched-account identities block composition apply and must not create another copy. Before account sync, duplicate managed identities with no pending feature/attachment changes are backup-gated and collapsed by one durable map commit; ambiguous edited copies remain untouched and block sync.
